def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # find 2x2 blocks of 2s (top-left corners, dedupe)
    blocks=[]
    for i in range(h-1):
        for j in range(w-1):
            if all(g[a][b]==2 for a in (i,i+1) for b in (j,j+1)):
                if all((i,bj)!=(a,b) for a,b in blocks) and (i,j) not in [(a+di,b+dj) for a,b in blocks for di,dj in [(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]]:
                    blocks.append((i,j))
    for bi,bj in blocks:
        ci,cj=bi+0.5,bj+0.5
        corners=[(bi-1,bj-1),(bi-1,bj+2),(bi+2,bj+2),(bi+2,bj-1)]
        for (i,j) in corners:
            if not(0<=i<h and 0<=j<w) or g[i][j] in (0,2): continue
            c=g[i][j]
            a,b=i-ci,j-cj
            # rotate 90 CW: (a,b)->(b,-a)
            ri,rj=int(ci+b),int(cj-a)
            di,dj=(1 if b>0 else -1),(-1 if a>0 else 1)
            x,y=ri,rj
            while 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w:
                out[x][y]=c
                x+=di; y+=dj
    return out
